title: Reply: interaction between different kinds is a problem only for causation by impact

statements.text: The objection that mind and body are too different to interact rests on a billiard ball picture of causation. If causation is by a more ethereal force or is only constant conjunction, there is no problem in principle with mind and body interacting.

sources.quote: there would appear to be no problem in principle with the idea of interaction of mind and body
